free_tier.stated: Free: '100GB included' OR 300 total assets, whichever comes first. API 1K calls/month. Paid Pro $10/mo/member = 2 TB + 1 TB per added member up to 10 TB.

egress.terms: CDN links are a paid-tier feature ('CDN links' listed under Pro). Free tier egress not metered but also not CDN-served.

tooling: Documented developer API (dev.playbook.com), 1,000 calls/month on free. No rclone backend.
chaining: 100 GB per account, and a second account carries a second allowance, but the 300-asset cap binds first for bulk data — 300 objects at 100 GB means ~333 MB average object.
limits_note: 300 assets OR 100 GB, whichever first — this is an asset-count cap disguised as a storage cap, the same failure mode as TeraBox's 500-file cap. API 1K calls/month is request-rate bound.
reliability_note: Designed for creatives (image/video preview), not bulk objects. No egress story. Below the 500 GB floor unless a second account carries a second allowance.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.
